name: Banknote Authentication
description: The Banknote Authentication dataset from the UCI Machine Learning Repository consists of 1,372 instances with 4 continuous numerical features extracted from genuine and counterfeit banknote-like specimens using wavelet transforms. Images of 400x400 pixels at approximately 660 dpi were captured using an industrial print-inspection camera. Features comprise the variance, skewness, and curtosis of the Wavelet Transformed image, along with the image entropy, paired with a binary class label indicating authenticity (0 for genuine, 1 for forged).

provenance.collection_method: Digitized from genuine and forged banknote-like specimens using an industrial print-inspection camera. Features were extracted using Wavelet Transform tools from 400x400 pixel grayscale images with ~660 dpi resolution.
provenance.curation_notes: Donated to UCI in 2012 by Volker Lohweg of University of Applied Sciences Ostwestfalen-Lippe (Hochschule Ostwestfalen-Lippe). The dataset does not define official train/test splits; the sample counts denote class distribution: 762 genuine (class 0) and 610 counterfeit (class 1) instances.
